title: Hearty Crisp Greek Lamb Tiropita
description: A sweet and crisp Greek dish featuring lamb shoulder, perfect for a sick day, made with lamination puff pastry and served on a cedar plank, also vegetarian friendly by substituting lamb with portobello mushrooms

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.notes: or 1 cup portobello mushrooms for vegetarian option

instructions: Roll out puff pastry to a large rectangle
In a bowl mix together lamb shoulder, feta cheese, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, sun dried tomatoes, and fresh parsley
Place the mixture onto one half of the pastry rectangle
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling to form a triangle
Brush the pastry with a little bit of water and sprinkle with sesame seeds
Place the tiropita on a cedar plank and bake for 25 minutes
Increase oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes or until golden brown
Let cool for a few minutes before serving
